_comment: OASIS's default /vsl router rules (HANDOVER 2026-10-12 section 4), in the forms.routing shape lib/forms/routing.ts parses (migration bravo__220). The draft seed validates and persists the matching rules from vsl.json. Applying the seed still creates a switched-off form and a draft page only; publishing remains a separate operator action.
_order: First match wins, so EXPLICIT path choices come first and inferences after: otherwise a visitor who picks FLEET, PROTOCOL or COMMUNITY with a budget would hit the budget branch of the command rule and be overridden. The one deliberate exception is rule 1: $250K+ a month goes to FLEET whatever card was picked.
